name: Housing
description: Housing supply, affordability and land use.

questions.oppose_means: Favors leaving housing density near transit to local zoning decisions.
questions.support_means: Favors state rules that permit denser housing near transit regardless of local zoning.
questions.text: Should state law allow taller, denser housing near major transit stops even where local zoning does not?

questions.oppose_means: Favors keeping existing height and density limits.
questions.support_means: Favors allowing added height and density citywide, including on western and northern corridors.
questions.text: Should San Francisco allow taller, denser housing in neighborhoods where zoning now limits height and density, as in the 2025 citywide rezoning plan?
questions.notes: Drafted from Mission Local's weekly candidate questions; approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-03.

questions.text: Should San Francisco extend rent control to more rental units, as far as state law allows?
